entries.6d35b3d7dd4b5f5e: It will continue the strategy by which it has grown by making capital investments such as mechanization of the manufacturing process ahead of other companies and providing products in large volumes and at low prices, and will continue to aim to improve production capacity and production efficiency through active capital investment. In addition to maintaining and expanding its share in the Chugoku, Shikoku and Kinki regions, its home ground, its priority strategy is to use the Mt. Fuji Foothills Plant to begin in earnest sales activities in the Kanto region, the largest market in Japan, and expand its share. In addition, it will work on automation of products that are difficult to make but in high demand, and aim to raise its selling prices by having business partners recognize the quality and value of its products.
